responsibility: This target mode-definition file adds SPARC-specific machine modes beyond GCC’s generic set. It defines TFmode as IEEE quad precision, OImode for 32-byte aggregate returns in the 64-bit ABI, the SPARC condition-code modes used to distinguish ICC/XCC and floating-point comparison semantics, and the vector integer modes used by VIS operations, thereby establishing backend data representations referenced throughout sparc.md and sparc.cc.
